summary: Legacy VB6 application with critical security and maintainability issues. Modern Python framework shows good architectural patterns but lacks integration testing.

hotspots.reason: No visible password hashing, encryption, or secure session management in frmLogin
Direct ADO usage without parameterized queries increases SQL injection risk
No visible error handling or input validation in form controls
No test files detected for critical modernization agents

provenance.evidence: 172 Python files with no corresponding test files

risks.title: Authentication Bypass Risk

risks.title: Modernization Framework Gaps

risks.title: Legacy Technology Dependencies
